description: Business validation rules for pacs.008.001.10 (Customer Credit Transfer) messages

rules.description: Settlement amount must be positive
rules.suggestion: Ensure the settlement amount is a positive decimal value greater than zero

rules.description: Instructed amount must be positive if present
rules.suggestion: Ensure the instructed amount is a positive decimal value greater than zero

rules.description: Amount decimal precision must match currency specification
rules.suggestion: Check ISO 4217 currency specification for correct decimal places (e.g., 2 for USD/EUR, 0 for JPY, 3 for BHD)

rules.description: Settlement amount and instructed amount currencies should be consistent if both present
rules.suggestion: If currencies differ, provide an exchange rate in XchgRate field

rules.description: Settlement date must not be in the past
rules.suggestion: Ensure the settlement date is today or a future date

rules.description: Settlement date should not be more than 365 days in the future
rules.suggestion: Review if settlement date is unusually far in the future

rules.description: Creation date/time must not be in the future
rules.suggestion: Ensure the creation date/time is not set to a future timestamp

rules.description: Currency code must be valid ISO 4217
rules.suggestion: Use a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY)

rules.description: Instructed amount currency must be valid ISO 4217 if present
rules.suggestion: Use a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code

rules.description: Instructing agent BIC must be valid
rules.suggestion: Ensure BIC is 8 or 11 characters following ISO 9362 format (e.g., DEUTDEFF or DEUTDEFFXXX)

rules.description: Instructed agent BIC must be valid
rules.suggestion: Ensure BIC is 8 or 11 characters following ISO 9362 format

rules.description: Debtor agent BIC must be valid if present
rules.suggestion: Ensure BIC is 8 or 11 characters following ISO 9362 format

rules.description: Creditor agent BIC must be valid if present
rules.suggestion: Ensure BIC is 8 or 11 characters following ISO 9362 format

rules.description: Intermediary agent BIC must be valid if present
rules.suggestion: Ensure BIC is 8 or 11 characters following ISO 9362 format

rules.description: Debtor account IBAN must be valid if present
rules.suggestion: Ensure IBAN passes Mod-97 check digit validation and matches country format

rules.description: Creditor account IBAN must be valid if present
rules.suggestion: Ensure IBAN passes Mod-97 check digit validation and matches country format

rules.description: Debtor name must be present
rules.suggestion: Provide the name of the ordering customer

rules.description: Creditor name must be present
rules.suggestion: Provide the name of the beneficiary customer

rules.description: Debtor or debtor account must be present
rules.suggestion: Provide either debtor party details or debtor account identification

rules.description: Creditor or creditor account must be present
rules.suggestion: Provide either creditor party details or creditor account identification

rules.description: Debtor agent must be present
rules.suggestion: Provide the debtor's financial institution (ordering institution)

rules.description: Creditor agent must be present
rules.suggestion: Provide the creditor's financial institution (beneficiary bank)

rules.description: End-to-end ID must be present
rules.suggestion: Provide a unique end-to-end reference for transaction tracking

rules.description: Instruction ID must be present
rules.suggestion: Provide a unique instruction identifier

rules.description: UETR must be valid UUID format if present
rules.suggestion: Ensure UETR follows UUID format (e.g., 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000)

rules.description: Charge bearer code must be valid
rules.suggestion: Use valid charge bearer code: CRED (beneficiary pays), DEBT (debtor pays), SHAR (shared), SLEV (service level)

rules.description: SEPA payments must use shared charge bearer
rules.suggestion: SEPA payments require charge bearer to be SHAR (shared)

rules.description: Charge amount must be positive if present
rules.suggestion: Ensure charge amount is a positive value

rules.description: SEPA payment amount must not exceed 999999999.99 EUR
rules.suggestion: SEPA payments must be in EUR and not exceed 999999999.99

rules.description: SEPA payment debtor and creditor agents must be in SEPA zone
rules.assertion: bic_country(DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI) in sepa_countries() AND bic_country(CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI) in sepa_countries()
rules.suggestion: Both debtor and creditor banks must be located in SEPA countries (EU27 + EEA + CH + UK + MC + SM + VA + AD)

rules.description: SEPA payment accounts must use IBAN
rules.suggestion: SEPA payments require both debtor and creditor accounts to be identified by IBAN

rules.description: Large payments may require regulatory reporting
rules.condition: if IntrBkSttlmAmt > 10000 AND (bic_country(DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI) in eu_countries() OR bic_country(CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI) in eu_countries())
rules.suggestion: Consider including regulatory reporting information for large cross-border EU payments

rules.description: High-value payments should include purpose code
rules.suggestion: Include payment purpose information for high-value transactions to aid regulatory compliance

rules.description: Settlement method must be valid if present
rules.suggestion: Use valid settlement method code: INDA (correspondent banking), INGA (instructing agent), COVE (cover method), CLRG (clearing system)

rules.description: Clearing system must be present if settlement method is CLRG
rules.suggestion: When using clearing system settlement method, specify the clearing system

rules.description: Message ID must be present and unique
rules.suggestion: Provide a unique message identifier (typically UUID format)

rules.description: Number of transactions must match actual count
rules.suggestion: Ensure NbOfTxs field matches the actual number of CdtTrfTxInf elements

rules.description: Total interbank settlement amount should match sum if present
rules.suggestion: Total settlement amount in header should equal sum of all transaction settlement amounts

rules.description: Exchange rate must be positive if present
rules.suggestion: Exchange rate must be a positive decimal value

rules.description: Exchange rate should be provided when currencies differ
rules.condition: if InstdAmt exists AND IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy != InstdAmt/@Ccy
rules.suggestion: When settlement and instructed amounts have different currencies, provide the exchange rate
